hypotheses.C0_exact_batched_recurrence: The batched all-attention recurrence matches independent autograd gradients to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.C1_varimax_sparsifies_upstream_gradients: Varimax top-64 gradient energy exceeds matched-random p95 by at least 0.02 at every source layer.
hypotheses.C2_varimax_sparsifies_native_contributio: Varimax top-64 absolute activation-weighted contribution mass exceeds matched-random p95 by at least 0.02 at every source layer.
hypotheses.C3_varimax_beats_native_upstream: Varimax exceeds native axes by at least 0.02 on both gradient and contribution top-64 fractions at every layer.
hypotheses.C4_sparse_basis_is_depth_consistent: The same non-random basis has the best contribution compactness at every source layer.
hypotheses.C5_local_compactness_survives_finite_edi: For varimax top-64 scale-0.1 ablations, linear predictions have correlation at least 0.90 and sign agreement at least 95% with finite effects at Layers 0 and 3.
